messages:
Asha (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses. I'll capture the facts and next steps. Please add one-line notes.
Tom (Sales): Win: payments startup chose us for Dedicated latency guarantees. Loss: logistics customer wanted on-prem HSM and 7-year logging retention.
Ruth (CS): Common asks: customer-managed keys, longer trace/log retention, clearer Dedicated vs Private docs, and a simple audit checklist.
Kai (Security): For KMS/HSM we need to define supported key flows and minimum attestation scope before offering templated language to sales.
Tom (Sales): Can we offer a temporary attestation for deals blocked by KMS? That would buy time while we build customer-managed keys.
Ellen (CEO): We can approve scoped attestations case-by-case. Long-term priority remains customer-managed keys + retention options.
Asha (Product): Proposed 60-day plan: 1) Feasibility doc for KMS/HSM 2) Audit checklist and sample answers 3) One-pager Dedicated vs Private 4) Short-term attestation template.
InfraBot: Perf job queued: reproduce p99 tail latency under burst for quantized models.
Ruth (CS): I'll draft the audit checklist and gather the top 10 lost deals with blockers.
Tom (Sales): I'll push for priority accounts and list contact names who requested on-prem KMS.
Asha (Product): Action owners noted. I'll post a GH project and schedule a 30-minute triage sync Friday. Keep replies short so we can move fast. :thumbsup:
